props.body: We operate a global payments network spanning remittance providers, PSPs, stablecoin issuers, and payment networks. Through a unified infrastructure layer, partners enable collections, disbursements, and cross-border settlement across fiat and stablecoin rails — faster, lower cost, and 24/7.
